channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-LaTeX
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: paper-preflight — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Checks every cited reference of a LaTeX project against Crossref, dblp, arXiv, DataCite, PubMed and OpenAlex records (existence, metadata mismatches, retractions) and reports undefined, duplicate and unused citation keys. Also available as a pre-commit hook, GitHub Action and MCP server.

item.title: overleaf-comments-export — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Exports comment threads, replies and tracked changes to Markdown and JSON, and annotates the compiled PDF with highlights on the commented text.

item.title: latexci BibTeX tools — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Browser-based .bib cleaner (removes duplicates, normalizes author names, escapes special characters) plus DOI, arXiv, PubMed and ISBN to BibTeX lookups, with no install and no account.

item.title: blacktex — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Command-line tool that replaces commonly occurring LaTeX anti-patterns and cleans up your files.

item.title: betterbib — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Command-line utility for improving your BibTeX files. Fetches information from online sources.

item.title: VerbTeX — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: LaTeX editor for the browser plus native Android, iOS, and Windows apps, with optional offline compilation on device. Freemium.

item.title: TikZJax — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Renders TikZ diagrams to SVG in the browser by running TeX via WebAssembly.

item.title: Texpile — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Free and open-source desktop editor that edits LaTeX visually (like LyX) or by source with IntelliSense, with local compilation and built-in Git. Also supports Typst and Markdown.

item.title: TeXlyre — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Local-first, open-source browser editor for LaTeX with in-browser WebAssembly compilation, offline editing, and peer-to-peer collaboration via WebRTC.

item.title: TeXLive.net — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Public compile service (used by LearnLaTeX.org) that turns an HTTP POST of a LaTeX document into a PDF.

item.title: SwiftLaTeX — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: pdfTeX and XeTeX compiled to WebAssembly, so you can compile LaTeX entirely in the browser or embed a TeX engine in a webpage.

item.title: SciTeX Writer — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Manuscript compilation system with templates for manuscripts, revisions, and supplementary materials, plus figure, table, and citation handling, and an MCP server (38 tools).

item.title: SciTeX Cloud — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Self-hostable online editor with AI assistant integration, figure/table/citation management, real-time collaboration, and an MCP server (29 tools).

item.title: RustFig — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: xfig rebuilt for Windows, macOS, Linux and the browser (no X server): LaTeX text typeset on the canvas, and every fig2dev export built in (TikZ, PSTricks, pict2e, pstex/pdftex, PDF, EPS, SVG). Reads and writes xfig's .fig files.

item.title: OpenAlex Local — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Local OpenAlex database (284M scholarly works) with abstracts and semantic search for literature discovery, and an MCP server.

item.title: Murfy — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Online LaTeX editor with real-time collaboration and built-in AI assistance for writing and error fixing. Freemium.

item.title: ModernTex — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Native macOS LaTeX editor for academic writing, with synced source and PDF, plain-language error messages, submission-readiness checks, a visual TikZ designer and a table editor. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time $19.99.

item.title: Mathpix — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: OCR app and API that converts images and PDFs of printed or handwritten equations, tables, and text into LaTeX. Freemium; paid Pro and API.

item.title: MathPoint — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: PowerPoint and Word add-in that typesets LaTeX equations, TikZ figures and tables on a server, so no local TeX installation is needed. Freemium.

item.title: MathLive — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Web component for editing and displaying math with LaTeX, including virtual keyboards and MathML/speech export.

item.title: LaTeX.Online — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Cloud compiler that builds a PDF from a Git repository, a URL, or pasted TeX; also available as a self-hosted Docker image.

item.title: LaTeX Pro — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: LaTeX and BibTeX plugin for IntelliJ IDEA and other JetBrains IDEs, with project-wide navigation and refactoring, local builds, PDF preview with SyncTeX, and bibliography management. Paid ($30/yr, 7-day trial).

item.title: LaTeX Editor — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Single-executable desktop editor with live PDF preview, two-way SyncTeX, LaTeX-aware spell checking, and one-key project snapshots written as a standard Git repository. Needs a separate TeX distribution.

item.title: Kroki — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Unified HTTP API that renders text-based diagrams, including PGF/TikZ, to SVG, PNG, or PDF. Self-hostable.

item.title: KaTeX — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Math rendering library made by Khan Academy focusing on fast load times. All output is processed as plain HTML instead of fixed images.

item.title: IguanaTex — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: PowerPoint add-in that inserts LaTeX equations typeset by your local TeX distribution and keeps the source with each shape, so you can edit and re-typeset it later.

item.title: Gummi — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Simple GTK LaTeX editor with a continuously updating live preview pane.

item.title: CrossRef Local — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Local CrossRef database (167M papers) with full-text search, impact factor data, Python API for bibliography enrichment, and an MCP server (15 tools).

item.title: CoCalc — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Collaborative online LaTeX editor with real-time editing, TimeTravel history, and first-class SageTeX, PythonTeX, and Knitr support. Freemium.

item.title: BiblioAudit — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Command-line tool to check, verify, and repair citations in BibTeX files across 12+ academic databases.

item.title: Biber — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Modern bibliography processor for biblatex, with Unicode support and more flexible sorting than BibTeX.

item.title: BibTeX Style Examples — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Example output of common BibTeX styles (BST files).

item.title: Aldine — via awesome-LaTeX
item.description: Self-hosted online editor with real-time collaboration in which every project is a Git repository, with branches in the editor and push/pull to GitHub, GitLab and Gitea.
